ssn.description: Schedule 3 header field 'Your social security number'. On these public-release scans this value is usually masked/redacted: transcribe exactly the characters that are legible; null if fully redacted or blank.
ssn.title: Your social security number (Schedule 3)

line_1_foreign_tax_credit.description: Schedule 3 Part I line 1 'Foreign tax credit'. Attach Form 1116 if required. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.
line_1_foreign_tax_credit.title: Line 1 foreign tax credit

line_2_dependent_care_credit.description: Schedule 3 Part I line 2 'Credit for child and dependent care expenses from Form 2441, line 11'. Attach Form 2441. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.
line_2_dependent_care_credit.title: Line 2 credit for child and dependent care expenses

line_3_education_credits.description: Schedule 3 Part I line 3 'Education credits from Form 8863, line 19'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.
line_3_education_credits.title: Line 3 education credits

line_4_retirement_savings_credit.description: Schedule 3 Part I line 4 'Retirement savings contributions credit'. Attach Form 8880. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.
line_4_retirement_savings_credit.title: Line 4 retirement savings contributions credit

line_5_residential_energy_credits.description: Schedule 3 Part I line 5 'Residential energy credits'. Attach Form 5695. (In 2022 this is a single line; the 2023 revision splits it into separate 5a 'Residential clean energy credit' and 5b 'Energy efficient home improvement credit' lines.) Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.
line_5_residential_energy_credits.title: Line 5 residential energy credits

other_nonrefundable_credits.description: Schedule 3 Part I line 6 'Other nonrefundable credits:' write-in grid, sublines '6a' through '6z' ('General business credit', 'Adoption credit', 'Qualified plug-in motor vehicle credit', etc.). One row per subline with a nonblank write-in or amount; empty grid → null.
other_nonrefundable_credits.title: Line 6 other nonrefundable credits (6a-6z)

line_7_total_other_nonrefundable_credits.description: Schedule 3 Part I line 7 'Total other nonrefundable credits. Add lines 6a through 6z'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.
line_7_total_other_nonrefundable_credits.title: Line 7 total other nonrefundable credits

line_8_part1_total.description: Schedule 3 Part I line 8 'Add lines 1 through 5 and 7'. Carried to Form 1040 line 20. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.
line_8_part1_total.title: Line 8 Part I total

line_9_net_premium_tax_credit.description: Schedule 3 Part II line 9 'Net premium tax credit'. Attach Form 8962. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.
line_9_net_premium_tax_credit.title: Line 9 net premium tax credit

line_10_extension_payment.description: Schedule 3 Part II line 10 'Amount paid with request for extension to file'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.
line_10_extension_payment.title: Line 10 amount paid with extension request

line_11_excess_ss_rrta_withheld.description: Schedule 3 Part II line 11 'Excess social security and tier 1 RRTA tax withheld'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.
line_11_excess_ss_rrta_withheld.title: Line 11 excess social security and tier 1 RRTA tax withheld

line_12_fuel_tax_credit.description: Schedule 3 Part II line 12 'Credit for federal tax on fuels'. Attach Form 4136. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.
line_12_fuel_tax_credit.title: Line 12 credit for federal tax on fuels

line_13a_form_2439.description: Schedule 3 Part II line '13a' 'Form 2439' (under line 13 'Other payments or refundable credits:'). Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.
line_13a_form_2439.title: Line 13a Form 2439

line_13b_sick_family_leave_credit_pre_ap.description: Schedule 3 Part II line '13b' 'Credit for qualified sick and family leave wages paid in 2022 from Schedule(s) H for leave taken before April 1, 2021'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.
line_13b_sick_family_leave_credit_pre_ap.title: Line 13b credit for qualified sick/family leave wages (leave before Apr 1, 2021)

line_13d_repayment_credit.description: Schedule 3 Part II line '13d' 'Credit for repayment of amounts included in income from earlier' years (2023 revision relabels this as line 13b). Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.
line_13d_repayment_credit.title: Line 13d credit for repayment of amounts included in income

line_13f_deferred_965_liability.description: Schedule 3 Part II line '13f' 'Deferred amount of net 965 tax liability (see instructions)' (2023 revision relabels this as line 13d). Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.
line_13f_deferred_965_liability.title: Line 13f deferred amount of net 965 tax liability

line_13h_sick_family_leave_credit_post_m.description: Schedule 3 Part II line '13h' 'Credit for qualified sick and family leave wages paid in 2022 from Schedule(s) H for leave taken after March 31, 2021, and before October 1, 2021'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.
line_13h_sick_family_leave_credit_post_m.title: Line 13h credit for qualified sick/family leave wages (leave Apr 1-Sep 30, 2021)

line_13z_other_type.description: Schedule 3 Part II line '13z' 'Other payments or refundable credits. List type and amount' — the write-in TYPE text (not the amount). Extract the string verbatim as printed; null if blank.
line_13z_other_type.title: Line 13z other payments/credits type

line_13z_other_amount.description: Schedule 3 Part II line '13z' 'Other payments or refundable credits. List type and amount' — the amount in the 13z entry box. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.
line_13z_other_amount.title: Line 13z other payments/credits amount

line_14_total_other_payments_credits.description: Schedule 3 Part II line 14 'Total other payments or refundable credits. Add lines 13a through 13z'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.
line_14_total_other_payments_credits.title: Line 14 total other payments or refundable credits

line_15_part2_total.description: Schedule 3 Part II line 15 'Add lines 9 through 12 and 14'. Carried to Form 1040 line 31. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.
line_15_part2_total.title: Line 15 Part II total

Form1116CountryColumn.title: Form 1116 Part I foreign country/possession column (A/B/C)

column_label.title: Column letter
column_label.description: Column letter printed in the Part I grid header 'Foreign Country or U.S. Possession', i.e. 'A', 'B', or 'C'. Extract exactly as printed; null if the column is entirely blank.

country_name.title: Line i country or U.S. possession name
country_name.description: Line 'i' 'Enter the name of the foreign country or U.S. possession' for this column. Extract the string verbatim as printed; null if blank. Identifies the country column when populated; if blank, keep columns in print order (A, B, C).

line_1a_income_description.title: Line 1a income type description (write-in)
line_1a_income_description.description: Line '1a' write-in description on the dotted lines under the Gross income from sources within country shown above heading. Extract the string verbatim as printed; null if blank.

line_1a_gross_income.title: Line 1a gross income from sources within country
line_1a_gross_income.description: Line '1a' boxed amount cell for this column: gross income from sources within the country shown above and of the type checked above. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

line_2_expenses_definitely_related.title: Line 2 expenses definitely related to line 1a income
line_2_expenses_definitely_related.description: Line 2 'Expenses definitely related to the income on line 1a (attach statement)' for this column. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

line_3a_itemized_or_standard_deduction.title: Line 3a certain itemized/standard deduction
line_3a_itemized_or_standard_deduction.description: Line '3a' 'Certain itemized deductions or standard deduction' under 'Pro rata share of other deductions not definitely related' for this column. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

line_3b_other_deductions.title: Line 3b other deductions
line_3b_other_deductions.description: Line '3b' 'Other deductions (attach statement)' for this column. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

line_3c_add_3a_3b.title: Line 3c add lines 3a and 3b
line_3c_add_3a_3b.description: Line '3c' 'Add lines 3a and 3b' for this column. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

line_3d_gross_foreign_source_income.title: Line 3d gross foreign source income
line_3d_gross_foreign_source_income.description: Line '3d' 'Gross foreign source income' for this column. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

line_3e_gross_income_all_sources.title: Line 3e gross income from all sources
line_3e_gross_income_all_sources.description: Line '3e' 'Gross income from all sources' for this column. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

line_3f_divide_3d_by_3e.title: Line 3f divide line 3d by line 3e
line_3f_divide_3d_by_3e.description: Line '3f' 'Divide line 3d by line 3e'. Decimal ratio as a JSON number (not whole-dollar); null if the entry box is blank.

line_3g_multiply_3c_by_3f.title: Line 3g multiply line 3c by line 3f
line_3g_multiply_3c_by_3f.description: Line '3g' 'Multiply line 3c by line 3f' for this column. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

line_4a_home_mortgage_interest.title: Line 4a home mortgage interest
line_4a_home_mortgage_interest.description: Line '4a' 'Home mortgage interest' under 'Pro rata share of interest expense', computed using the Worksheet for Home Mortgage Interest in the instructions, for this column. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

line_4b_other_interest_expense.title: Line 4b other interest expense
line_4b_other_interest_expense.description: Line '4b' 'Other interest expense' for this column. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

line_5_losses_from_foreign_sources.title: Line 5 losses from foreign sources
line_5_losses_from_foreign_sources.description: Line 5 'Losses from foreign sources' for this column. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

line_6_add_2_3g_4a_4b_5.title: Line 6 add lines 2, 3g, 4a, 4b, and 5
line_6_add_2_3g_4a_4b_5.description: Line 6 'Add lines 2, 3g, 4a, 4b, and 5' for this column. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

line_7_subtract_6_from_1a.title: Line 7 subtract line 6 from line 1a
line_7_subtract_6_from_1a.description: Line 7 'Subtract line 6 from line 1a'. Enter the result here and on line 15, page 2, for this column. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

Form1116ForeignTaxRow.title: Form 1116 Part II foreign taxes paid or accrued row (A/B/C)

row_label.title: Row letter
row_label.description: Row letter printed in the left margin 'Country' column of the Part II grid, i.e. 'A', 'B', or 'C'. Extract exactly as printed; null if the row is entirely blank.

country_name.title: Country (Part II row)
country_name.description: Country or U.S. possession name written in the leftmost 'Country' column for this Part II row. Extract the string verbatim as printed; null if blank. Identifies the row when populated; if blank, keep rows in print order (A, B, C) and correlated with the same-lettered Part I column.

credit_claimed_paid_box.title: Column (j) Paid box
credit_claimed_paid_box.description: Column '(j)' 'Paid' checkbox under "Credit is claimed for taxes (you must check one)" for this row. True if the box is checked; false if the box is printed but left unchecked (including when 'Accrued' is checked instead). Two-state policy: true ONLY if this box is marked; false otherwise. Return null only if this page is not present.

credit_claimed_accrued_box.title: Column (k) Accrued box
credit_claimed_accrued_box.description: Column '(k)' 'Accrued' checkbox under "Credit is claimed for taxes (you must check one)" for this row. True if the box is checked; false if the box is printed but left unchecked (including when 'Paid' is checked instead). Two-state policy: true ONLY if this box is marked; false otherwise. Return null only if this page is not present.

date_paid_or_accrued.title: Column (l) date paid or accrued
date_paid_or_accrued.description: Column '(l) Date paid or accrued' for this row. Extract the string verbatim as printed (do not reformat); null if blank.

foreign_currency_dividends.title: Column (m) dividends withheld, in foreign currency
foreign_currency_dividends.description: Column '(m) Dividends' under "Taxes withheld at source on:" 'In foreign currency' for this row. Amount as a JSON number in the foreign currency as printed (not U.S. dollars); an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

foreign_currency_rents_and_royalties.title: Column (n) rents and royalties withheld, in foreign currency
foreign_currency_rents_and_royalties.description: Column '(n) Rents and royalties' under "Taxes withheld at source on:" 'In foreign currency' for this row. Amount as a JSON number in the foreign currency as printed; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

foreign_currency_interest.title: Column (o) interest withheld, in foreign currency
foreign_currency_interest.description: Column '(o) Interest' under "Taxes withheld at source on:" 'In foreign currency' for this row. Amount as a JSON number in the foreign currency as printed; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

foreign_currency_other_taxes.title: Column (p) other foreign taxes paid or accrued, in foreign currency
foreign_currency_other_taxes.description: Column '(p) Other foreign taxes paid or accrued' 'In foreign currency' for this row. Amount as a JSON number in the foreign currency as printed; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

usd_dividends.title: Column (q) dividends withheld, in U.S. dollars
usd_dividends.description: Column '(q) Dividends' under "Taxes withheld at source on:" 'In U.S. dollars' for this row. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

usd_rents_and_royalties.title: Column (r) rents and royalties withheld, in U.S. dollars
usd_rents_and_royalties.description: Column '(r) Rents and royalties' under "Taxes withheld at source on:" 'In U.S. dollars' for this row. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

usd_interest.title: Column (s) interest withheld, in U.S. dollars
usd_interest.description: Column '(s) Interest' under "Taxes withheld at source on:" 'In U.S. dollars' for this row. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

usd_other_taxes.title: Column (t) other foreign taxes paid or accrued, in U.S. dollars
usd_other_taxes.description: Column '(t) Other foreign taxes paid or accrued' 'In U.S. dollars' for this row. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

usd_total_foreign_taxes.title: Column (u) total foreign taxes paid or accrued
usd_total_foreign_taxes.description: Column '(u) Total foreign taxes paid or accrued', computed as "add cols. (q) through (t)", for this row. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

Form1116.title: Form 1116 (2022) — Foreign Tax Credit (Individual, Estate, or Trust)

name.title: Name
name.description: Form 1116 header field 'Name'. Extract the string verbatim as printed; null if blank.

identifying_number.title: Identifying number
identifying_number.description: Form 1116 header field "Identifying number as shown on page 1 of your tax return". On these public-release scans this value is usually masked/redacted: transcribe exactly the characters that are legible; null if fully redacted or blank.

category_section_951a_box.title: Box a: Section 951A category income
category_section_951a_box.description: Category-of-income checkbox 'a' 'Section 951A category income'. True if checked; false if printed but left unchecked. Only one of the eight category-of-income boxes (a-g, plus h is a text field) should be true for a given Form 1116. Two-state policy: true ONLY if this box is marked; false otherwise. Return null only if this page is not present.

category_foreign_branch_box.title: Box b: Foreign branch category income
category_foreign_branch_box.description: Category-of-income checkbox 'b' 'Foreign branch category income'. True if checked; false if printed but left unchecked. Two-state policy: true ONLY if this box is marked; false otherwise. Return null only if this page is not present.

category_passive_box.title: Box c: Passive category income
category_passive_box.description: Category-of-income checkbox 'c' 'Passive category income'. True if checked; false if printed but left unchecked. Two-state policy: true ONLY if this box is marked; false otherwise. Return null only if this page is not present.

category_general_box.title: Box d: General category income
category_general_box.description: Category-of-income checkbox 'd' 'General category income'. True if checked; false if printed but left unchecked. Two-state policy: true ONLY if this box is marked; false otherwise. Return null only if this page is not present.

category_section_901j_box.title: Box e: Section 901(j) income
category_section_901j_box.description: Category-of-income checkbox 'e' 'Section 901(j) income'. True if checked; false if printed but left unchecked. Two-state policy: true ONLY if this box is marked; false otherwise. Return null only if this page is not present.

category_resourced_by_treaty_box.title: Box f: Certain income re-sourced by treaty
category_resourced_by_treaty_box.description: Category-of-income checkbox 'f' 'Certain income re-sourced by treaty'. True if checked; false if printed but left unchecked. Two-state policy: true ONLY if this box is marked; false otherwise. Return null only if this page is not present.

category_lump_sum_distributions_box.title: Box g: Lump-sum distributions
category_lump_sum_distributions_box.description: Category-of-income checkbox 'g' 'Lump-sum distributions'. True if checked; false if printed but left unchecked. Two-state policy: true ONLY if this box is marked; false otherwise. Return null only if this page is not present.

resident_of_country.title: Line h: Resident of (name of country)
resident_of_country.description: Line 'h' "Resident of (name of country)" write-in text (not a checkbox). Extract the string verbatim as printed; null if blank.

countries.title: Part I foreign country/possession columns A/B/C (lines i, 1a-7)
countries.description: Part I 'Taxable Income or Loss From Sources Outside the United States' grid, columns 'A', 'B', 'C' under "Foreign Country or U.S. Possession", spanning line 'i' "Enter the name of the foreign country or U.S. possession" through line 7 'Subtract line 6 from line 1a'. One column per listed country/possession (up to 3, per the form note: use column A alone if only one foreign country or U.S. possession, else a separate column for each); empty grid → null.

line_1b_compensation_alternative_basis_b.title: Line 1b check if line 1a is compensation with alternative basis
line_1b_compensation_alternative_basis_b.description: Line '1b' 'Check if line 1a is compensation for personal services as an employee' where total compensation from all sources is $250,000 or more and an alternative basis was used to determine its source. This single checkbox is printed once (to the left of the A/B/C grid), not per country column. True if checked; false if printed but left unchecked. Two-state policy: true ONLY if this box is marked; false otherwise. Return null only if this page is not present.

line_1a_total_gross_income.title: Line 1a Total column (add cols. A, B, and C)
line_1a_total_gross_income.description: Part I line '1a' 'Total' column value, computed as "Add cols. A, B, and C". Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

line_6_total.title: Line 6 Total column (add cols. A, B, and C)
line_6_total.description: Part I line 6 'Total' column value for "Add lines 2, 3g, 4a, 4b, and 5", computed as add cols. A, B, and C. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

line_7_total.title: Line 7 Total column (add cols. A, B, and C)
line_7_total.description: Part I line 7 'Total' column value for 'Subtract line 6 from line 1a', computed as add cols. A, B, and C. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

foreign_taxes.title: Part II foreign taxes paid or accrued rows A/B/C
foreign_taxes.description: Part II 'Foreign Taxes Paid or Accrued' grid, rows 'A', 'B', 'C' in the left 'Country' column, spanning column (j) 'Paid' through column (u) 'Total foreign taxes paid or accrued'. One row per listed country (up to 3, correlated with the same-lettered Part I column); empty grid → null. Does not include the '8 Add lines A through C' summary row, which is modeled as a fixed field.

line_8_total_foreign_taxes.title: Line 8 total foreign taxes paid or accrued (all rows)
line_8_total_foreign_taxes.description: Part II line 8 "Add lines A through C, column (u)." Enter the total here and on line 9, page 2. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

line_9_total_foreign_taxes_from_line_8.title: Line 9 total foreign taxes paid or accrued (from line 8)
line_9_total_foreign_taxes_from_line_8.description: Part III line 9 'Enter the amount from line 8'. These are the total foreign taxes paid or accrued for the category of income checked above Part I. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

line_10_carryover_and_carrybacks.title: Line 10 carryover and carrybacks of foreign taxes
line_10_carryover_and_carrybacks.description: Part III line 10 'Enter the sum of any carryover of foreign taxes' (from Schedule B, line 3, column (xiv)) plus any carrybacks to the current tax year. Leave blank if income is section 951A category income (box a). Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

line_11_add_9_10.title: Line 11 add lines 9 and 10
line_11_add_9_10.description: Part III line 11 'Add lines 9 and 10'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

line_12_reduction_in_foreign_taxes.title: Line 12 reduction in foreign taxes
line_12_reduction_in_foreign_taxes.description: Part III line 12 'Reduction in foreign taxes'. Printed inside parentheses on the form (a filled entry is a reduction, i.e. negative). Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

line_13_taxes_reclassified_high_tax_kick.title: Line 13 taxes reclassified under high tax kickout
line_13_taxes_reclassified_high_tax_kick.description: Part III line 13 'Taxes reclassified under high tax kickout'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

line_14_total_foreign_taxes_available.title: Line 14 combine lines 11-13, total foreign taxes available for credit
line_14_total_foreign_taxes_available.description: Part III line 14 'Combine lines 11, 12, and 13'. This is the total amount of foreign taxes available for credit. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

line_15_taxable_income_from_line_7.title: Line 15 taxable income or (loss) from line 7
line_15_taxable_income_from_line_7.description: Part III line 15 'Enter the amount from line 7'. This is the taxable income or (loss) from sources outside the United States (before adjustments) for the category of income checked above Part I. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

line_16_adjustments_to_line_15.title: Line 16 adjustments to line 15
line_16_adjustments_to_line_15.description: Part III line 16 'Adjustments to line 15'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

line_17_net_foreign_source_taxable_incom.title: Line 17 combine lines 15 and 16, net foreign source taxable income
line_17_net_foreign_source_taxable_incom.description: Part III line 17 'Combine the amounts on lines 15 and 16'. This is the net foreign source taxable income; if zero or less, no foreign tax credit applies for this category and lines 18-24 are skipped (line 20 must still be completed if filing more than one Form 1116). Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

line_18_taxable_income_before_exemption.title: Line 18 taxable income (individuals: Form 1040 line 15; estates/trusts: without exemption deduction)
line_18_taxable_income_before_exemption.description: Part III line 18 'Individuals'. Individuals enter the amount from line 15 of Form 1040, 1040-SR, or 1040-NR; estates and trusts enter taxable income without the deduction for the exemption. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

line_19_divide_17_by_18.title: Line 19 divide line 17 by line 18
line_19_divide_17_by_18.description: Part III line 19 'Divide line 17 by line 18'. If line 17 is more than line 18, enter '1'. Decimal ratio as a JSON number (not whole-dollar); null if the entry box is blank.

identifying_number.description: Form 4952 header field 'Identifying number'. On public-release scans this value is often masked/redacted: transcribe exactly the characters that are legible; null if fully redacted or blank.

line_1_investment_interest_expense_paid.title: Line 1 investment interest expense paid or accrued
line_1_investment_interest_expense_paid.description: Form 4952 Part I line 1 'Investment interest expense paid or accrued in 2022 (see instructions)'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

line_2_disallowed_carryover_prior_year.title: Line 2 disallowed investment interest expense carried over from 2021
line_2_disallowed_carryover_prior_year.description: Form 4952 Part I line 2 'Disallowed investment interest expense from 2021 Form 4952, line 7'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.

line_3_total_investment_interest_expense.title: Line 3 total investment interest expense
line_3_total_investment_interest_expense.description: Form 4952 Part I line 3 'Total investment interest expense. Add lines 1 and 2'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.

line_4a_gross_income_from_investment_pro.title: Line 4a gross income from property held for investment
line_4a_gross_income_from_investment_pro.description: Form 4952 Part II line '4a' 'Gross income from property held for investment (excluding any net gain from the disposition of property held for investment)'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.

line_4b_qualified_dividends_on_4a.title: Line 4b qualified dividends included on line 4a
line_4b_qualified_dividends_on_4a.description: Form 4952 Part II line '4b' 'Qualified dividends included on line 4a'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.

line_4c_subtract_4b_from_4a.title: Line 4c (4a minus 4b)
line_4c_subtract_4b_from_4a.description: Form 4952 Part II line '4c' 'Subtract line 4b from line 4a'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.

line_4d_net_gain_disposition_investment_.title: Line 4d net gain from disposition of investment property
line_4d_net_gain_disposition_investment_.description: Form 4952 Part II line '4d' 'Net gain from the disposition of property held for investment'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.

line_4d_elec_writein_amount.title: Line 4d dotted-line 'Elec.' write-in amount
line_4d_elec_writein_amount.description: Form 4952 Part II dotted-line write-in beside line 4e: filer writes 'Elec.' on the dotted line and enters the part of line 4e elected as attributable to line 4g. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the dotted line is blank.

line_4e_smaller_of_4d_or_net_capital_gai.title: Line 4e smaller of line 4d or net capital gain
line_4e_smaller_of_4d_or_net_capital_gai.description: Form 4952 Part II line '4e' 'Enter the smaller of line 4d or your net capital gain from the disposition of property held for investment'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.

line_4f_subtract_4e_from_4d.title: Line 4f (4d minus 4e)
line_4f_subtract_4e_from_4d.description: Form 4952 Part II line '4f' 'Subtract line 4e from line 4d'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.

line_4g_elected_amount_included_in_inves.title: Line 4g elected amount from lines 4b and 4e included in investment income
line_4g_elected_amount_included_in_inves.description: Form 4952 Part II line '4g' 'Enter the amount from lines 4b and 4e that you elect to include in investment income'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.

line_4h_investment_income.title: Line 4h investment income
line_4h_investment_income.description: Form 4952 Part II line '4h' 'Investment income. Add lines 4c, 4f, and 4g'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.

line_5_investment_expenses.title: Line 5 investment expenses
line_5_investment_expenses.description: Form 4952 Part II line 5 'Investment expenses (see instructions)'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.

line_6_net_investment_income.title: Line 6 net investment income
line_6_net_investment_income.description: Form 4952 Part II line 6 'Net investment income. Subtract line 5 from line 4h. If zero or less, enter -0-'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.

line_7_disallowed_carryforward_to_2023.title: Line 7 disallowed investment interest expense carried forward to 2023
line_7_disallowed_carryforward_to_2023.description: Form 4952 Part III line 7 'Disallowed investment interest expense to be carried forward to 2023'. Subtract line 6 from line 3; if zero or less, enter -0-. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.

line_8_investment_interest_expense_deduc.title: Line 8 investment interest expense deduction
line_8_investment_interest_expense_deduc.description: Form 4952 Part III line 8 'Investment interest expense deduction. Enter the smaller of line 3 or line 6'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.

names_shown.title: Name(s) shown on return
names_shown.description: Form 8995 header field 'Name(s) shown on return'. Extract the string verbatim as printed; null if blank.

taxpayer_id_number.title: Your taxpayer identification number
taxpayer_id_number.description: Form 8995 header field 'Your taxpayer identification number'. On public-release scans this value is often masked/redacted: transcribe exactly the characters that are legible; null if fully redacted or blank.

businesses.title: Line 1 trade/business QBI component table
businesses.description: Form 8995 Part I line 1 table listing each 'Trade, business, or aggregation name' (col a) with 'Taxpayer identification number' (col b) and 'Qualified business income or (loss)' (col c), on printed sub-rows i-v (up to 5 businesses). Null if the table is empty.

line_2_total_qbi.title: Line 2 total qualified business income or (loss)
line_2_total_qbi.description: Form 8995 line 2 'Total qualified business income or (loss)'. Combine lines 1i through 1v, column (c). Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.

line_3_qbi_loss_carryforward_prior_year.title: Line 3 qualified business net (loss) carryforward from the prior year
line_3_qbi_loss_carryforward_prior_year.description: Form 8995 line 3 'Qualified business net (loss) carryforward from the prior year'. Printed with parentheses (a filled entry is negative). Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.

line_4_total_qbi_combined.title: Line 4 total qualified business income
line_4_total_qbi_combined.description: Form 8995 line 4 'Total qualified business income'. Combine lines 2 and 3; if zero or less, enter -0-. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.

line_5_qbi_component.title: Line 5 qualified business income component
line_5_qbi_component.description: Form 8995 line 5 'Qualified business income component. Multiply line 4 by 20% (0.20)'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.

line_6_qualified_reit_ptp_income.title: Line 6 qualified REIT dividends and PTP income or (loss)
line_6_qualified_reit_ptp_income.description: Form 8995 line 6 'Qualified REIT dividends and publicly traded partnership (PTP) income or (loss)'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.

line_7_reit_ptp_loss_carryforward_prior_.title: Line 7 qualified REIT/PTP (loss) carryforward from the prior year
line_7_reit_ptp_loss_carryforward_prior_.description: Form 8995 line 7 'Qualified REIT dividends and qualified PTP (loss) carryforward' from the prior year. Printed with parentheses (a filled entry is negative). Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.

line_8_total_reit_ptp_income.title: Line 8 total qualified REIT dividends and PTP income
line_8_total_reit_ptp_income.description: Form 8995 line 8 'Total qualified REIT dividends and PTP income'. Combine lines 6 and 7; if zero or less, enter -0-. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.

line_9_reit_ptp_component.title: Line 9 REIT and PTP component
line_9_reit_ptp_component.description: Form 8995 line 9 'REIT and PTP component. Multiply line 8 by 20% (0.20)'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.

line_10_qbi_deduction_before_income_limi.title: Line 10 QBI deduction before the income limitation
line_10_qbi_deduction_before_income_limi.description: Form 8995 line 10 'Qualified business income deduction before the income limitation'. Add lines 5 and 9. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.

line_11_taxable_income_before_qbi_deduct.title: Line 11 taxable income before QBI deduction
line_11_taxable_income_before_qbi_deduct.description: Form 8995 line 11 'Taxable income before qualified business income deduction (see instructions)'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.

line_12_net_capital_gain.title: Line 12 net capital gain
line_12_net_capital_gain.description: Form 8995 line 12 'Net capital gain (see instructions)'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.

line_13_subtract_12_from_11.title: Line 13 (line 11 minus line 12)
line_13_subtract_12_from_11.description: Form 8995 line 13 'Subtract line 12 from line 11. If zero or less, enter -0-'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.

line_14_income_limitation.title: Line 14 income limitation
line_14_income_limitation.description: Form 8995 line 14 'Income limitation. Multiply line 13 by 20% (0.20)'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.

line_15_qbi_deduction.title: Line 15 qualified business income deduction
line_15_qbi_deduction.description: Form 8995 line 15 'Qualified business income deduction. Enter the smaller of line 10 or line 14'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.

line_16_total_qbi_loss_carryforward.title: Line 16 total qualified business (loss) carryforward
line_16_total_qbi_loss_carryforward.description: Form 8995 line 16 'Total qualified business (loss) carryforward'. Combine lines 2 and 3; if greater than zero, enter -0-. Printed with parentheses (a filled entry is negative). Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.

line_17_total_reit_ptp_loss_carryforward.title: Line 17 total qualified REIT dividends and PTP (loss) carryforward
line_17_total_reit_ptp_loss_carryforward.description: Form 8995 line 17 'Total qualified REIT dividends and PTP (loss) carryforward'. Combine lines 6 and 7; if greater than zero, enter -0-. Printed with parentheses (a filled entry is negative). Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.

name_of_business.title: Trade, business, or aggregation name
name_of_business.description: Column '(a) Trade, business, or aggregation name' of the Form 8995 line 1 table. Extract the string verbatim as printed; identifies this business's row when populated; null if blank.

taxpayer_id_number.title: Taxpayer identification number
taxpayer_id_number.description: Column '(b) Taxpayer identification number' of the Form 8995 line 1 table. On public-release scans this value is often masked/redacted: transcribe exactly the characters that are legible; null if fully redacted or blank.

qbi_amount.title: Qualified business income or (loss)
qbi_amount.description: Column '(c) Qualified business income or (loss)' of the Form 8995 line 1 table. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

name_shown_on_form_1040.description: Header field 'Name(s) shown on Form 1040, 1040-SR, or 1040-NR'. Extract the string verbatim as printed; null if blank.
name_shown_on_form_1040.title: Name(s) shown on Form 1040, 1040-SR, or 1040-NR

your_social_security_number.description: Header field 'Your social security number'. On these public-release scans this value is usually masked/redacted: transcribe exactly the characters that are legible; null if fully redacted or blank.
your_social_security_number.title: Your social security number

line_1_form_1040_line_15_or_adjustment.description: Part I line '1' 'Enter the amount from Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 15, if more than zero'. If that line is zero, subtract line 14 of Form 1040 or 1040-SR from line 11 of Form 1040 or 1040-SR and enter the result; if less than zero, enter as a negative amount. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; a parenthesized or minus-signed amount is negative; null if the entry box is blank.
line_1_form_1040_line_15_or_adjustment.title: Line 1 amount from Form 1040/1040-SR line 15 (or recomputed)

line_2a_taxes_from_schedule_a.description: Part I line '2a' 'If filing Schedule A (Form 1040), enter the taxes from Schedule A, line 7'; otherwise, enter the amount from Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 12. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.
line_2a_taxes_from_schedule_a.title: Line 2a taxes from Schedule A (or standard deduction)

line_2b_tax_refund.description: Part I line '2b' 'Tax refund from Schedule 1 (Form 1040), line 1 or line 8z'. Printed inside parentheses on the form, so a filled entry is a negative number. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.
line_2b_tax_refund.title: Line 2b tax refund from Schedule 1

line_2c_investment_interest_expense.description: Part I line '2c' 'Investment interest expense (difference between regular tax and AMT)'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.
line_2c_investment_interest_expense.title: Line 2c investment interest expense

line_2d_depletion.description: Part I line '2d' 'Depletion (difference between regular tax and AMT)'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.
line_2d_depletion.title: Line 2d depletion

line_2e_net_operating_loss_deduction.description: Part I line '2e' 'Net operating loss deduction from Schedule 1 (Form 1040), line 8a'. Enter as a positive amount. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.
line_2e_net_operating_loss_deduction.title: Line 2e net operating loss deduction

line_2f_alternative_tax_net_operating_lo.description: Part I line '2f' 'Alternative tax net operating loss deduction'. Printed inside parentheses on the form, so a filled entry is a negative number. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.
line_2f_alternative_tax_net_operating_lo.title: Line 2f alternative tax net operating loss deduction

line_2g_private_activity_bond_interest.description: Part I line '2g' 'Interest from specified private activity bonds exempt from the regular tax'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.
line_2g_private_activity_bond_interest.title: Line 2g interest from specified private activity bonds

line_2h_qualified_small_business_stock.description: Part I line '2h' 'Qualified small business stock, see instructions'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.
line_2h_qualified_small_business_stock.title: Line 2h qualified small business stock

line_2i_incentive_stock_options.description: Part I line '2i' 'Exercise of incentive stock options'. Enter the excess of AMT income over regular tax income. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.
line_2i_incentive_stock_options.title: Line 2i exercise of incentive stock options

line_2j_estates_and_trusts.description: Part I line '2j' 'Estates and trusts (amount from Schedule K-1 (Form 1041), box 12, code A)'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.
line_2j_estates_and_trusts.title: Line 2j estates and trusts

line_2k_disposition_of_property.description: Part I line '2k' 'Disposition of property (difference between AMT and regular tax gain or loss)'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.
line_2k_disposition_of_property.title: Line 2k disposition of property

line_2l_depreciation_post_1986.description: Part I line '2l' 'Depreciation on assets placed in service after 1986'. Difference between regular tax and AMT depreciation. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.
line_2l_depreciation_post_1986.title: Line 2l depreciation on assets placed in service after 1986

line_2m_passive_activities.description: Part I line '2m' 'Passive activities (difference between AMT and regular tax income or loss)'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.
line_2m_passive_activities.title: Line 2m passive activities

line_2n_loss_limitations.description: Part I line '2n' 'Loss limitations (difference between AMT and regular tax income or loss)'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.
line_2n_loss_limitations.title: Line 2n loss limitations

line_2o_circulation_costs.description: Part I line '2o' 'Circulation costs (difference between regular tax and AMT)'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.
line_2o_circulation_costs.title: Line 2o circulation costs

line_2p_long_term_contracts.description: Part I line '2p' 'Long-term contracts (difference between AMT and regular tax income)'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.
line_2p_long_term_contracts.title: Line 2p long-term contracts

line_2q_mining_costs.description: Part I line '2q' 'Mining costs (difference between regular tax and AMT)'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.
line_2q_mining_costs.title: Line 2q mining costs

line_2r_research_and_experimental_costs.description: Part I line '2r' 'Research and experimental costs (difference between regular tax and AMT)'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.
line_2r_research_and_experimental_costs.title: Line 2r research and experimental costs

line_2s_installment_sales_before_1987.description: Part I line '2s' 'Income from certain installment sales before January 1, 1987'. Printed inside parentheses on the form, so a filled entry is a negative number. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.
line_2s_installment_sales_before_1987.title: Line 2s income from certain installment sales before 1/1/1987

line_2t_intangible_drilling_costs_prefer.description: Part I line '2t' 'Intangible drilling costs preference'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.
line_2t_intangible_drilling_costs_prefer.title: Line 2t intangible drilling costs preference

line_3_other_adjustments.description: Part I line '3' 'Other adjustments, including income-based related adjustments'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.
line_3_other_adjustments.title: Line 3 other adjustments

line_4_alternative_minimum_taxable_incom.description: Part I line '4' 'Alternative minimum taxable income'. Combine lines 1 through 3 (if married filing separately and line 4 is more than $776,100, see instructions). Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.
line_4_alternative_minimum_taxable_incom.title: Line 4 alternative minimum taxable income

line_5_exemption.description: Part II line '5' 'Exemption'. Determined from the printed filing-status table on this line: Single or head of household with line 4 not over $539,900 enters $75,900; Married filing jointly or qualifying widow(er) with line 4 not over $1,079,800 enters $118,100; Married filing separately with line 4 not over $539,900 enters $59,050; if line 4 is over the amount shown for the filer's status, see instructions for a phased-out amount. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.
line_5_exemption.title: Line 5 exemption amount

line_6_subtract_5_from_4.description: Part II line '6' 'Subtract line 5 from line 4'. If more than zero, go to line 7; if zero or less, enter -0- here and on lines 7, 9, and 11, and go to line 10. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.
line_6_subtract_5_from_4.title: Line 6 subtract line 5 from line 4

line_7_tax_or_part_iii_amount.description: Part II 'line 7', computed under one of several bracketed conditions: filers of Form 2555 use the instructions worksheet amount; filers with capital gain distributions, qualified dividends, or Schedule D gains on both lines 15 and 16 complete Part III and enter the amount from line 40; all others multiply line 6 by 26% (0.26) if line 6 is $206,100 or less ($103,050 or less if married filing separately), otherwise multiply by 28% (0.28) and subtract $4,122 ($2,061 if married filing separately) from the result. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.
line_7_tax_or_part_iii_amount.title: Line 7 tentative tax (or amount from Part III line 40)

line_8_amt_foreign_tax_credit.description: Part II line '8' 'Alternative minimum tax foreign tax credit (see instructions)'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.
line_8_amt_foreign_tax_credit.title: Line 8 alternative minimum tax foreign tax credit

line_9_tentative_minimum_tax.description: Part II line '9' 'Tentative minimum tax'. Subtract line 8 from line 7. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.
line_9_tentative_minimum_tax.title: Line 9 tentative minimum tax

line_10_regular_tax_for_amt.description: Part II line '10', computed as: add Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 16 (minus any tax from Form 4972), and Schedule 2 (Form 1040), line 2; subtract from the result Schedule 3 (Form 1040), line 1 and any negative amount reported on Form 8978, line 14 (treated as a positive number). If zero or less, enter -0-. If Schedule J was used to figure Form 1040/1040-SR line 16 tax, refigure that tax without Schedule J before completing this line; see instructions. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.
line_10_regular_tax_for_amt.title: Line 10 regular tax computed for AMT purposes

line_11_amt.description: Part II line '11' 'AMT'. Subtract line 10 from line 9; if zero or less, enter -0-. Enter here and on Schedule 2 (Form 1040), line 1. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.
line_11_amt.title: Line 11 AMT (alternative minimum tax)

line_12_amount_from_line_6.description: Part III line '12' 'Enter the amount from Form 6251, line 6'. If filing Form 2555, enter the amount from line 3 of the worksheet in the instructions for line 7 instead. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.
line_12_amount_from_line_6.title: Line 12 amount from Form 6251 line 6 (or Form 2555 worksheet)

line_13_qdcgt_or_schedule_d_worksheet_am.description: Part III line '13'. Enter the amount from line 4 of the Qualified Dividends and Capital Gain Tax Worksheet in the Form 1040 instructions, or the amount from line 13 of the Schedule D Tax Worksheet in the Schedule D instructions, whichever applies (as refigured for the AMT, if necessary); see instructions, including for Form 2555 filers. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.
line_13_qdcgt_or_schedule_d_worksheet_am.title: Line 13 Qualified Dividends and Capital Gain Tax / Schedule D Tax Worksheet amount

line_14_schedule_d_line_19.description: Part III line '14' 'Enter the amount from Schedule D (Form 1040), line 19' (as refigured for the AMT, if necessary); see instructions, including for Form 2555 filers. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.
line_14_schedule_d_line_19.title: Line 14 amount from Schedule D line 19

line_15_smaller_of_13_or_combined.description: Part III line '15'. If no Schedule D Tax Worksheet was completed for the regular tax or the AMT, enter the amount from line 13; otherwise add lines 13 and 14 and enter the smaller of that result or the amount from line 10 of the Schedule D Tax Worksheet (as refigured for the AMT, if necessary); see instructions, including for Form 2555 filers. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.
line_15_smaller_of_13_or_combined.title: Line 15 smaller of line 13, or lines 13+14 vs. Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 10

line_16_smaller_of_12_or_15.description: Part III line '16' 'Enter the smaller of line 12 or line 15'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.
line_16_smaller_of_12_or_15.title: Line 16 smaller of line 12 or line 15

line_17_subtract_16_from_12.description: Part III line '17' 'Subtract line 16 from line 12'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.
line_17_subtract_16_from_12.title: Line 17 subtract line 16 from line 12

line_18_tax_on_line_17.description: Part III line '18'. If line 17 is $206,100 or less ($103,050 or less if married filing separately), multiply line 17 by 26% (0.26); otherwise multiply line 17 by 28% (0.28) and subtract $4,122 ($2,061 if married filing separately) from the result. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.
line_18_tax_on_line_17.title: Line 18 tax computed on line 17

line_19_applicable_threshold.description: Part III line '19': printed filing-status amounts of $83,350 (married filing jointly or qualifying widow(er)), $41,675 (single or married filing separately), or $55,800 (head of household); enter the amount matching the filer's status. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.
line_19_applicable_threshold.title: Line 19 applicable filing-status threshold amount

line_20_qdcgt_or_schedule_d_regular_tax_.description: Part III line '20'. Enter the amount from line 5 of the Qualified Dividends and Capital Gain Tax Worksheet or line 14 of the Schedule D Tax Worksheet, whichever applies (as figured for the regular tax); if neither worksheet was completed for the regular tax, enter the amount from Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 15 (if zero or less, enter -0-); see instructions, including for Form 2555 filers. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.
line_20_qdcgt_or_schedule_d_regular_tax_.title: Line 20 QDCGT/Schedule D Tax Worksheet amount (regular tax)

line_21_subtract_20_from_19.description: Part III line '21' 'Subtract line 20 from line 19. If zero or less, enter -0-'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.
line_21_subtract_20_from_19.title: Line 21 subtract line 20 from line 19

line_22_smaller_of_12_or_13.description: Part III line '22' 'Enter the smaller of line 12 or line 13'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.
line_22_smaller_of_12_or_13.title: Line 22 smaller of line 12 or line 13

line_23_smaller_of_21_or_22_taxed_at_0_p.description: Part III line '23' 'Enter the smaller of line 21 or line 22'. This amount is taxed at 0%. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.
line_23_smaller_of_21_or_22_taxed_at_0_p.title: Line 23 smaller of line 21 or line 22 (taxed at 0%)

line_24_subtract_23_from_22.description: Part III line '24' 'Subtract line 23 from line 22'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.
line_24_subtract_23_from_22.title: Line 24 subtract line 23 from line 22

row_label.title: Row letter

donee_name_and_address.title: Column (a) name and address of the donee organization
donee_name_and_address.description: Line 1 column '(a) Name and address of the donee organization' for this row. Extract the string verbatim as printed (name and address may be combined into one string as written); null if blank. Identifies the donated-property row when populated; if blank, keep rows in print order (A-E).

vehicle_box.title: Column (b) vehicle checkbox
vehicle_box.description: Line 1 column '(b)' "If donated property is a vehicle (see instructions), check the box" for this row. True if the box is checked; false if the box is printed but left unchecked. Two-state policy: true ONLY if this box is marked; false otherwise (unmarked, or not printed on this rendering). Return null only if this page is not present.

vehicle_identification_number.description: Line 1 column '(b)' write-in boxes: "Also enter the vehicle identification number (unless Form 1098-C is attached)", for this row. Extract the string verbatim as printed (one character per printed box, concatenated); null if blank or if Form 1098-C is attached instead.

description_and_condition.title: Column (c) description and condition of donated property
description_and_condition.description: Line 1 column '(c) Description and condition of donated property' for this row (for a vehicle, the year, make, model, and mileage; for securities and other property, per instructions). Extract the string verbatim as printed; null if blank.

date_of_contribution.title: Column (d) date of the contribution

date_acquired_by_donor.title: Column (e) date acquired by donor (mo., yr.)

section_b_property_type_intellectual_pro.title: Line 2h checkbox: Intellectual Property
section_b_property_type_intellectual_pro.description: Section B, Part I, line 2 checkbox '(h)' 'Intellectual Property' — one of the 'Check the box that describes the type of property donated' options. True if checked; false if printed but left unchecked. Return null only if this page is not present.

section_b_property_type_vehicles_box.title: Line 2i checkbox: Vehicles
section_b_property_type_vehicles_box.description: Section B, Part I, line 2 checkbox '(i)' 'Vehicles' — one of the 'Check the box that describes the type of property donated' options. True if checked; false if printed but left unchecked. Return null only if this page is not present.

section_b_property_type_clothing_househo.title: Line 2j checkbox: Clothing and household items
section_b_property_type_clothing_househo.description: Section B, Part I, line 2 checkbox '(j)' 'Clothing and household items' — one of the 'Check the box that describes the type of property donated' options. True if checked; false if printed but left unchecked. Return null only if this page is not present.

section_b_property_type_other_box.title: Line 2k checkbox: Other
section_b_property_type_other_box.description: Section B, Part I, line 2 checkbox '(k)' 'Other' — one of the 'Check the box that describes the type of property donated' options. True if checked; false if printed but left unchecked. Return null only if this page is not present.

section_b_rows.title: Section B Part I donated property rows A-C (line 3)
section_b_rows.description: Section B 'Donated Property Over $5,000', Part I 'Information on Donated Property' line 3 grid, rows A through C, columns (a) Description of donated property through (i) Date of contribution. Complete for one item (or group of similar items) for which the filer claimed a deduction of more than $5,000 per item or group. One row per listed item (up to 3); empty grid → null.

line_4a_property_letter_partial_interest.title: Line 4a letter from Section B, Part I identifying the partial-interest property
line_4a_property_letter_partial_interest.description: Part II line '4a' write-in: the letter from Section B, Part I that identifies the property for which the donor gave less than an entire interest. If Section B, Part II applies to more than one property, a separate statement is attached. Extract the string verbatim as printed (the identifying letter); null if blank.

line_4b1_deduction_this_tax_year.title: Line 4b(1) total deduction claimed for this tax year
line_4b1_deduction_this_tax_year.description: Part II line '4b' total amount claimed as a deduction for the property listed in Section B, Part I, sub-line '(1) For this tax year'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

line_4b2_deduction_prior_tax_years.title: Line 4b(2) total deduction claimed for any prior tax years
line_4b2_deduction_prior_tax_years.description: Part II line '4b' sub-line '(2) For any prior tax years' — total amount claimed as a deduction for the property listed in Section B, Part I, in prior tax years. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

line_4c_prior_year_donee_name.title: Line 4c name of charitable organization (donee), prior-year gift
line_4c_prior_year_donee_name.description: Part II line '4c' 'Name of charitable organization (donee)' entry (complete only if different from the donee organization in Section B, Part V), for an organization to which a similar contribution was made in a prior year. Extract the string verbatim as printed; null if blank.

line_4c_prior_year_donee_address.title: Line 4c address (number, street, and room or suite no.), prior-year donee
line_4c_prior_year_donee_address.description: Part II line '4c' 'Address (number, street, and room or suite no.)' entry for the prior-year donee organization. Extract the string verbatim as printed; null if blank.

line_4c_prior_year_donee_city_state_zip.title: Line 4c city or town, state, and ZIP code, prior-year donee
line_4c_prior_year_donee_city_state_zip.description: Part II line '4c' 'City or town, state, and ZIP code' entry for the prior-year donee organization. Extract the string verbatim as printed; null if blank.

line_4d_property_location.title: Line 4d place where tangible property is located or kept
line_4d_property_location.description: Part II line '4d' "For tangible property, enter the place where the property is located or kept." Extract the string verbatim as printed; null if blank.

line_4e_person_with_possession.title: Line 4e name of person with actual possession of the property
line_4e_person_with_possession.description: Part II line '4e' write-in: name of any person, other than the donee organization, having actual possession of the property. Extract the string verbatim as printed; null if blank.

line_5a_restriction_on_donee_use_yes_box.title: Line 5a Yes box: restriction on donee's right to use or dispose
line_5a_restriction_on_donee_use_yes_box.description: Part II line '5a' restriction-on-donee-rights question — the 'Yes' checkbox for whether there is a restriction, temporary or permanent, on the right of the donee to use or dispose of the donated property. True if the 'Yes' box is checked; false if the box is printed but left unchecked (including when 'No' is checked instead). Two-state policy: true ONLY if this box is marked; false otherwise. Return null only if this page is not present.

line_5a_restriction_on_donee_use_no_box.title: Line 5a No box: restriction on donee's right to use or dispose
line_5a_restriction_on_donee_use_no_box.description: Part II line '5a' restriction-on-donee-rights question — the 'No' checkbox for whether there is a restriction, temporary or permanent, on the right of the donee to use or dispose of the donated property. True if the 'No' box is checked; false if the box is printed but left unchecked (including when 'Yes' is checked instead). Two-state policy: true ONLY if this box is marked; false otherwise. Return null only if this page is not present.

line_5b_right_to_income_or_possession_ye.title: Line 5b Yes box: gave right to income/possession to another party
line_5b_right_to_income_or_possession_ye.description: Part II line '5b' question on whether the donor gave to anyone other than the donee organization the right to the income from, or possession of, the donated property (including the right to vote donated securities, acquire the property, or designate the recipient) — the 'Yes' checkbox. True if the 'Yes' box is checked; false if the box is printed but left unchecked (including when 'No' is checked instead). Two-state policy: true ONLY if this box is marked; false otherwise. Return null only if this page is not present. Note: the printed form shades the 'No' column gray for this line; the 'Yes' box is the operative one printed with a clear response cell.

line_5c_restriction_limiting_use_yes_box.title: Line 5c Yes box: restriction limiting property to a particular use
line_5c_restriction_limiting_use_yes_box.description: Part II line '5c' 'Is there a restriction limiting the donated property for a particular use?' — the 'Yes' checkbox. True if the 'Yes' box is checked; false if the box is printed but left unchecked (including when 'No' is checked instead). Two-state policy: true ONLY if this box is marked; false otherwise. Return null only if this page is not present.

line_5c_restriction_limiting_use_no_box.title: Line 5c No box: restriction limiting property to a particular use
line_5c_restriction_limiting_use_no_box.description: Part II line '5c' 'Is there a restriction limiting the donated property for a particular use?' — the 'No' checkbox. True if the 'No' box is checked; false if the box is printed but left unchecked (including when 'Yes' is checked instead). Two-state policy: true ONLY if this box is marked; false otherwise. Return null only if this page is not present.

part_iii_taxpayer_statement.title: Part III taxpayer (donor) statement — identifying letter(s) and item description
part_iii_taxpayer_statement.description: Part III 'Taxpayer (Donor) Statement' write-in area: "Enter identifying letter from Section B, Part I and describe the specific item" for each item the appraisal identifies as having a value of $500 or less. Extract the string verbatim as printed (letter(s) plus description, as a single combined string); null if blank.

part_iii_taxpayer_signature.title: Part III Signature of taxpayer (donor)
part_iii_taxpayer_signature.description: Part III signature line 'Signature of taxpayer (donor)'. Extract the signer's name/mark as transcribed if legible; null if blank or illegible.

part_iii_date.title: Part III Date (taxpayer signature)
part_iii_date.description: Part III signature block 'Date' field, adjacent to 'Signature of taxpayer (donor)'. Extract the date string verbatim as printed; null if blank.

part_iv_appraiser_signature.title: Part IV Appraiser signature
part_iv_appraiser_signature.description: Part IV 'Declaration of Appraiser', 'Sign Here' block, 'Appraiser signature' field. Extract the signer's name/mark as transcribed if legible; null if blank or illegible.

part_iv_appraiser_signature_date.title: Part IV Date (appraiser signature)
part_iv_appraiser_signature_date.description: Part IV 'Sign Here' block 'Date' field, adjacent to 'Appraiser signature'. Extract the date string verbatim as printed; null if blank.

part_iv_appraiser_name.title: Part IV Appraiser name
part_iv_appraiser_name.description: Part IV 'Sign Here' block 'Appraiser name' field. Extract the string verbatim as printed; null if blank.

part_iv_appraiser_title.title: Part IV Appraiser title
part_iv_appraiser_title.description: Part IV 'Sign Here' block 'Title' field, adjacent to 'Appraiser name'. Extract the string verbatim as printed; null if blank.

part_iv_appraiser_business_address.title: Part IV Business address (including room or suite no.)
part_iv_appraiser_business_address.description: Part IV 'Sign Here' block 'Business address (including room or suite no.)' field. Extract the string verbatim as printed; null if blank.

part_iv_appraiser_identifying_number.title: Part IV Appraiser identifying number
part_iv_appraiser_identifying_number.description: Part IV 'Sign Here' block 'Identifying number' field for the appraiser. On these public-release scans this value may be masked/redacted: transcribe exactly the characters that are legible; null if fully redacted or blank.

part_iv_appraiser_city_state_zip.title: Part IV City or town, state, and ZIP code (appraiser)
part_iv_appraiser_city_state_zip.description: Part IV 'Sign Here' block 'City or town, state, and ZIP code' field for the appraiser's business address. Extract the string verbatim as printed; null if blank.

part_v_unrelated_use_yes_box.title: Part V Yes box: organization intends unrelated use
part_v_unrelated_use_yes_box.description: Part V 'Donee Acknowledgment' question "Does the organization intend to use the property for an unrelated use?" — the 'Yes' checkbox. True if the 'Yes' box is checked; false if the box is printed but left unchecked (including when 'No' is checked instead). Two-state policy: true ONLY if this box is marked; false otherwise. Return null only if this page is not present.

part_v_unrelated_use_no_box.title: Part V No box: organization intends unrelated use
part_v_unrelated_use_no_box.description: Part V 'Donee Acknowledgment' question "Does the organization intend to use the property for an unrelated use?" — the 'No' checkbox. True if the 'No' box is checked; false if the box is printed but left unchecked (including when 'Yes' is checked instead). Two-state policy: true ONLY if this box is marked; false otherwise. Return null only if this page is not present.

part_v_donee_receipt_date.title: Part V date donee received the donated property
part_v_donee_receipt_date.description: Part V 'Donee Acknowledgment' write-in: the date the organization received the donated property described in Section B, Part I. Extract the date string verbatim as printed; null if blank.

part_v_donee_name.description: Part V 'Donee Acknowledgment' block 'Name of charitable organization (donee)' field. Extract the string verbatim as printed; null if blank.

part_v_donee_ein.title: Part V Employer identification number (donee)
part_v_donee_ein.description: Part V 'Donee Acknowledgment' block 'Employer identification number' field for the donee organization. On these public-release scans this value may be masked/redacted: transcribe exactly the characters that are legible; null if fully redacted or blank.

part_v_donee_address.title: Part V Address (number, street, and room or suite no.), donee
part_v_donee_address.description: Part V 'Donee Acknowledgment' block 'Address (number, street, and room or suite no.)' field. Extract the string verbatim as printed; null if blank.

part_v_donee_city_state_zip.title: Part V City or town, state, and ZIP code, donee
part_v_donee_city_state_zip.description: Part V 'Donee Acknowledgment' block 'City or town, state, and ZIP code' field. Extract the string verbatim as printed; null if blank.

part_v_authorized_signature.title: Part V Authorized signature
part_v_authorized_signature.description: Part V 'Donee Acknowledgment' block 'Authorized signature' field. Extract the signer's name/mark as transcribed if legible; null if blank or illegible.
