line_6_modified_agi.title: Line 6 modified adjusted gross income
line_6_modified_agi.description: Part II line 6 'Enter modified adjusted gross income, but not less than zero.' If line 6 is greater than or equal to line 5, the printed note says skip lines 7 and 8 and enter -0- on line 9. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.

line_7_subtract_6_from_5.title: Line 7 subtract line 6 from line 5
line_7_subtract_6_from_5.description: Part II line 7 'Subtract line 6 from line 5'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.

line_8_multiply_line_7_by_50_pct.title: Line 8 multiply line 7 by 50% (0.50)
line_8_multiply_line_7_by_50_pct.description: Part II line 8 'Multiply line 7 by 50% (0.50).' Do not enter more than $25,000; if married filing separately, see instructions for a different cap. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.

line_9_smaller_of_4_or_8.title: Line 9 smaller of line 4 or line 8
line_9_smaller_of_4_or_8.description: Part II line 9 'Enter the smaller of line 4 or line 8'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.

line_10_add_income_1a_2a.title: Line 10 add the income, if any, on lines 1a and 2a
line_10_add_income_1a_2a.description: Part III line 10 'Add the income, if any, on lines 1a and 2a and enter the total'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.

line_11_total_losses_allowed.title: Line 11 total losses allowed from all passive activities for 2022
line_11_total_losses_allowed.description: Part III line 11 'Total losses allowed from all passive activities for 2022.' Add lines 9 and 10; see instructions to find out how to report the losses on the tax return. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.

part_iv_activities.title: Part IV activity grid (rental real estate with active participation)
part_iv_activities.description: Part IV 'Complete This Part Before Part I, Lines 1a, 1b, and 1c' activity grid: 'Name of activity' rows with columns (a) Net income (line 1a) through (e) Loss. The official 2022 blank prints 5 blank rows; one row per listed activity. Does not include the 'Total. Enter on Part I, lines 1a, 1b, and 1c' summary row, which is modeled as fixed fields. Empty grid (no activities listed) → null.

part_iv_total_current_year_net_income.title: Part IV Total — column (a) net income
part_iv_total_current_year_net_income.description: Part IV 'Total. Enter on Part I, lines 1a, 1b, and 1c' row, column '(a) Net income (line 1a)' subtotal. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.

part_iv_total_current_year_net_loss.title: Part IV Total — column (b) net loss
part_iv_total_current_year_net_loss.description: Part IV 'Total. Enter on Part I, lines 1a, 1b, and 1c' row, column '(b) Net loss (line 1b)' subtotal. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

part_iv_total_prior_years_unallowed_loss.title: Part IV Total — column (c) unallowed loss
part_iv_total_prior_years_unallowed_loss.description: Part IV 'Total. Enter on Part I, lines 1a, 1b, and 1c' row, column '(c) Unallowed loss (line 1c)' subtotal. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

part_v_activities.title: Part V activity grid (all other passive activities)
part_v_activities.description: Part V 'Complete This Part Before Part I, Lines 2a, 2b, and 2c' activity grid: 'Name of activity' rows with columns (a) Net income (line 2a) through (e) Loss. The official 2022 blank prints 5 blank rows; one row per listed activity. Does not include the 'Total. Enter on Part I, lines 2a, 2b, and 2c' summary row, which is modeled as fixed fields. Empty grid (no activities listed) → null.

part_v_total_current_year_net_income.title: Part V Total — column (a) net income
part_v_total_current_year_net_income.description: Part V 'Total. Enter on Part I, lines 2a, 2b, and 2c' row, column '(a) Net income (line 2a)' subtotal. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.

part_v_total_current_year_net_loss.title: Part V Total — column (b) net loss
part_v_total_current_year_net_loss.description: Part V 'Total. Enter on Part I, lines 2a, 2b, and 2c' row, column '(b) Net loss (line 2b)' subtotal. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

part_v_total_prior_years_unallowed_loss.title: Part V Total — column (c) unallowed loss
part_v_total_prior_years_unallowed_loss.description: Part V 'Total. Enter on Part I, lines 2a, 2b, and 2c' row, column '(c) Unallowed loss (line 2c)' subtotal. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

part_vi_allowances.title: Part VI special allowance grid
part_vi_allowances.description: Part VI 'Use This Part if an Amount Is Shown on Part II, Line 9' grid: 'Name of activity' rows with 'Form or schedule and line number to be reported on' plus columns (a) Loss through (d) Subtract column (c) from column (a). The official 2022 blank prints 5 blank rows; one row per listed activity. Does not include the 'Total' summary row, which is modeled as fixed fields. Empty grid → null.

part_vi_total_loss.title: Part VI Total — column (a) loss
part_vi_total_loss.description: Part VI 'Total' row, column '(a) Loss' subtotal. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

part_vi_total_ratio.title: Part VI Total — column (b) ratio
part_vi_total_ratio.description: Part VI 'Total' row, column '(b) Ratio' subtotal. The form pre-prints '1.00' as the expected total ratio. Decimal fraction as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.

part_vi_total_special_allowance.title: Part VI Total — column (c) special allowance
part_vi_total_special_allowance.description: Part VI 'Total' row, column '(c) Special allowance' subtotal. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.

part_vi_total_subtract_c_from_a.title: Part VI Total — column (d) subtract column (c) from column (a)
part_vi_total_subtract_c_from_a.description: Part VI 'Total' row, column "(d) Subtract column (c) from column (a)" subtotal. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

part_vii_allocations.title: Part VII allocation of unallowed losses grid
part_vii_allocations.description: Part VII 'Allocation of Unallowed Losses' grid: 'Name of activity' rows with 'Form or schedule and line number to be reported on' plus columns (a) Loss through (c) Unallowed loss. The official 2022 blank prints 5 blank rows; one row per listed activity. Does not include the 'Total' summary row, which is modeled as fixed fields. Empty grid → null.

part_vii_total_loss.title: Part VII Total — column (a) loss
part_vii_total_loss.description: Part VII 'Total' row, column '(a) Loss' subtotal. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

part_vii_total_ratio.title: Part VII Total — column (b) ratio
part_vii_total_ratio.description: Part VII 'Total' row, column '(b) Ratio' subtotal. The form pre-prints '1.00' as the expected total ratio. Decimal fraction as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.

part_vii_total_unallowed_loss.title: Part VII Total — column (c) unallowed loss
part_vii_total_unallowed_loss.description: Part VII 'Total' row, column '(c) Unallowed loss' subtotal. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

part_viii_allowed_losses.title: Part VIII allowed losses grid
part_viii_allowed_losses.description: Part VIII 'Allowed Losses' grid: 'Name of activity' rows with 'Form or schedule and line number to be reported on' plus columns (a) Loss through (c) Allowed loss. The official 2022 blank prints 5 blank rows; one row per listed activity. Does not include the 'Total' summary row, which is modeled as fixed fields. Empty grid → null.

part_viii_total_loss.title: Part VIII Total — column (a) loss
part_viii_total_loss.description: Part VIII 'Total' row, column '(a) Loss' subtotal. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

part_viii_total_unallowed_loss.title: Part VIII Total — column (b) unallowed loss
part_viii_total_unallowed_loss.description: Part VIII 'Total' row, column '(b) Unallowed loss' subtotal. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

part_viii_total_allowed_loss.title: Part VIII Total — column (c) allowed loss
part_viii_total_allowed_loss.description: Part VIII 'Total' row, column '(c) Allowed loss' subtotal. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.

part_ix_two_schedule_activities.title: Part IX activities with losses reported on two or more forms/schedules
part_ix_two_schedule_activities.description: Part IX 'Activities With Losses Reported on Two or More Forms or Schedules' grid. The official 2022 blank prints exactly 3 repeating blocks, each with 'Name of activity:', 'Form or schedule and line number to be reported on', and lines 1a-1c across columns (a)-(e). One block per listed activity (up to 3); does not include the final 'Total' summary row, which is modeled as fixed fields. Empty grid → null.

part_ix_total_col_b.title: Part IX Total — column (b)
part_ix_total_col_b.description: Part IX 'Total' row, unlabeled column (b) subtotal. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.

part_ix_total_ratio.title: Part IX Total — column (c) ratio
part_ix_total_ratio.description: Part IX 'Total' row, column '(c) Ratio' subtotal. The form pre-prints '1.00' as the expected total ratio. Decimal fraction as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.

part_ix_total_unallowed_loss.title: Part IX Total — column (d) unallowed loss
part_ix_total_unallowed_loss.description: Part IX 'Total' row, column '(d) Unallowed loss' subtotal. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

part_ix_total_allowed_loss.title: Part IX Total — column (e) allowed loss
part_ix_total_allowed_loss.description: Part IX 'Total' row, column '(e) Allowed loss' subtotal. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.

Form8879.title: Form 8879 (Rev. January 2021, used for TY 2022) — IRS e-file Signature Authorization

submission_identification_number.description: Header field 'Submission Identification Number (SID)', the 20-digit EFIN-based number assigned to the electronically filed return. Transcribe verbatim as printed/handwritten; null if blank.
submission_identification_number.title: Submission Identification Number (SID)

taxpayer_name.description: Header field 'Taxpayer's name' as entered from the tax return being authorized. Extract verbatim; null if blank.
taxpayer_name.title: Taxpayer's name

taxpayer_ssn.description: Header field 'Social security number' for the taxpayer. On public-release scans this is often masked/redacted: transcribe exactly the characters that are legible; null if fully redacted or blank.
taxpayer_ssn.title: Taxpayer's social security number

spouse_name.description: Header field 'Spouse's name', present only on a joint return. Extract verbatim; null if blank (including when the return has no spouse).
spouse_name.title: Spouse's name

spouse_ssn.description: Header field 'Spouse's social security number'. On public-release scans this is often masked/redacted: transcribe exactly the characters that are legible; null if fully redacted, blank, or no spouse.
spouse_ssn.title: Spouse's social security number

tax_year_ending.description: Part I caption 'Tax Year Ending December 31,' followed by a fill-in blank for the year being authorized (e.g. "2022"). Transcribe the entered year verbatim as a string; null if blank.
tax_year_ending.title: Part I tax year ending December 31, (year)

line_1_adjusted_gross_income.description: Part I line 1 'Adjusted gross income'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number, entered only when the filer is not a Form 1040-SS filer (Form 1040-SS filers leave this blank per the form's note). Null if the entry box is blank.
line_1_adjusted_gross_income.title: Line 1 adjusted gross income

line_2_total_tax.description: Part I line 2 'Total tax'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number, entered only when the filer is not a Form 1040-SS filer. Null if the entry box is blank.
line_2_total_tax.title: Line 2 total tax

line_3_federal_income_tax_withheld.description: Part I line 3 'Federal income tax withheld from Form(s) W-2 and Form(s) 1099'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number, entered only when the filer is not a Form 1040-SS filer. Null if the entry box is blank.
line_3_federal_income_tax_withheld.title: Line 3 federal income tax withheld from Form(s) W-2 and 1099

line_4_amount_refunded.description: Part I line 4 'Amount you want refunded to you'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; this is the one line Form 1040-SS filers do complete. Null if the entry box is blank.
line_4_amount_refunded.title: Line 4 amount you want refunded to you

line_5_amount_owed.description: Part I line 5 'Amount you owe'. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number, entered only when the filer is not a Form 1040-SS filer. Null if the entry box is blank.
line_5_amount_owed.title: Line 5 amount you owe

taxpayer_pin_authorize_ero_box.description: Part II 'Taxpayer's PIN: check one box only', first option box: 'I authorize' the named ERO firm 'to enter or generate my PIN ... as my signature on the income tax return'. True if checked, false if printed but left unchecked. Return null only if this page is not present.
taxpayer_pin_authorize_ero_box.title: Taxpayer's PIN box 1 — I authorize ERO to enter/generate my PIN

taxpayer_pin_ero_firm_name.description: Part II fill-in line under the taxpayer PIN authorization sentence, labeled 'ERO firm name', naming the electronic return originator firm authorized to enter/generate the taxpayer's PIN. Extract verbatim; null if blank.
taxpayer_pin_ero_firm_name.title: Taxpayer's PIN authorization — ERO firm name

taxpayer_pin_entered.description: Part II five-box PIN field next to 'Enter five digits, but don't enter all zeros', holding the taxpayer's self-selected or ERO-generated PIN. Transcribe exactly the legible digits as a string (may be partially masked on scans); null if fully redacted or blank.
taxpayer_pin_entered.title: Taxpayer's PIN (5 digits)

taxpayer_pin_self_entered_box.description: Part II 'Taxpayer's PIN: check one box only', second option box: 'I will enter my PIN as my signature on the income tax return (original or amended) I am now authorizing', checked only when the taxpayer enters their own PIN under the Practitioner PIN method (requires Part III). True if checked, false if printed but left unchecked. Return null only if this page is not present.
taxpayer_pin_self_entered_box.title: Taxpayer's PIN box 2 — I will enter my own PIN

taxpayer_signature.description: Part II signature line 'Your signature'. Transcribe the printed/typed/handwritten signature text present on the line (this is a signature block, not a normalized name field); null if the line is blank.
taxpayer_signature.title: Your signature

taxpayer_signature_date.description: Part II 'Date' field on the taxpayer signature line. Transcribe the date text exactly as written/printed (do not normalize the format, since this is part of a signature block); null if blank.
taxpayer_signature_date.title: Your signature — Date

spouse_pin_authorize_ero_box.description: Part II 'Spouse's PIN: check one box only', first option box: 'I authorize' the named ERO firm 'to enter or generate my PIN ... as my signature on the income tax return'. True if checked, false if printed but left unchecked. Return null only if this page is not present.
spouse_pin_authorize_ero_box.title: Spouse's PIN box 1 — I authorize ERO to enter/generate my PIN

spouse_pin_ero_firm_name.description: Part II fill-in line under the spouse PIN authorization sentence, labeled 'ERO firm name', naming the electronic return originator firm authorized to enter/generate the spouse's PIN. Extract verbatim; null if blank.
spouse_pin_ero_firm_name.title: Spouse's PIN authorization — ERO firm name

spouse_pin_entered.description: Part II five-box PIN field next to 'Enter five digits, but don't enter all zeros', holding the spouse's self-selected or ERO-generated PIN. Transcribe exactly the legible digits as a string (may be partially masked on scans); null if fully redacted or blank.
spouse_pin_entered.title: Spouse's PIN (5 digits)

spouse_pin_self_entered_box.description: Part II 'Spouse's PIN: check one box only', second option box: 'I will enter my PIN as my signature on the income tax return (original or amended) I am now authorizing', checked only when the spouse enters their own PIN under the Practitioner PIN method (requires Part III). True if checked, false if printed but left unchecked. Return null only if this page is not present.
spouse_pin_self_entered_box.title: Spouse's PIN box 2 — I will enter my own PIN

spouse_signature.description: Part II signature line 'Spouse's signature'. Transcribe the printed/typed/handwritten signature text present on the line (this is a signature block, not a normalized name field); null if the line is blank or there is no spouse.
spouse_signature.title: Spouse's signature

spouse_signature_date.description: Part II 'Date' field on the spouse signature line. Transcribe the date text exactly as written/printed (do not normalize the format, since this is part of a signature block); null if blank.
spouse_signature_date.title: Spouse's signature — Date

ero_efin_pin.description: Part III field 'ERO's EFIN/PIN', an eleven-character combined entry: the ERO's six-digit EFIN followed by the ERO's five-digit self-selected PIN. Transcribe exactly the legible characters as a single string (may be partially masked on scans); null if fully redacted, blank, or Part III is not completed (non-Practitioner-PIN returns).
ero_efin_pin.title: Part III — ERO's EFIN/PIN (11 characters)

ero_signature.description: Part III signature line 'ERO's signature'. Transcribe the printed/typed/handwritten signature text present on the line (this is a signature block, not a normalized name field); null if blank or Part III is not completed.
ero_signature.title: Part III — ERO's signature

ero_signature_date.description: Part III 'Date' field on the ERO signature line. Transcribe the date text exactly as written/printed (do not normalize the format, since this is part of a signature block); null if blank or Part III is not completed.
ero_signature_date.title: Part III — ERO's signature — Date

Form8949ShortTermRow.title: Form 8949 Part I short-term transaction row (line 1)

description_of_property.title: Column (a) description of property
description_of_property.description: Column '(a) Description of property' (Example: 100 sh. XYZ Co.) for this short-term transaction row. Extract the string verbatim as printed; null if blank. Identifies the row when populated; if blank, keep rows in print order.

date_acquired.title: Column (b) date acquired
date_acquired.description: Column '(b) Date acquired' (Mo., day, yr.) for this short-term transaction row. Extract exactly as printed (may read 'VARIOUS' instead of a date); null if blank.

date_sold_or_disposed.title: Column (c) date sold or disposed of
date_sold_or_disposed.description: Column '(c) Date sold or disposed of' (Mo., day, yr.) for this short-term transaction row. Extract exactly as printed; null if blank.

proceeds.title: Column (d) proceeds (sales price)
proceeds.description: Column '(d) Proceeds (sales price)' for this short-term transaction row. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

cost_or_other_basis.title: Column (e) cost or other basis
cost_or_other_basis.description: Column '(e) Cost or other basis' for this short-term transaction row. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

adjustment_code.title: Column (f) code(s) from instructions
adjustment_code.description: Column '(f) Code(s) from instructions' for this short-term transaction row, required when an amount is entered in column (g). Extract exactly as printed (one or more single-letter codes, e.g. 'B', 'W'); null if blank.

adjustment_amount.title: Column (g) amount of adjustment
adjustment_amount.description: Column '(g) Amount of adjustment' for this short-term transaction row, part of the 'Adjustment, if any, to gain or loss' block. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

gain_or_loss.title: Column (h) gain or (loss)
gain_or_loss.description: Column '(h) Gain or (loss)' for this short-term transaction row: subtract column (e) from column (d) and combine the result with column (g). Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

cost_or_other_basis.title: Column (e) cost or other basis
cost_or_other_basis.description: Column '(e) Cost or other basis' for this long-term transaction row. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

adjustment_code.title: Column (f) code(s) from instructions
adjustment_code.description: Column '(f) Code(s) from instructions' for this long-term transaction row, required when an amount is entered in column (g). Extract exactly as printed (one or more single-letter codes, e.g. 'B', 'W'); null if blank.

adjustment_amount.title: Column (g) amount of adjustment

Form8949.title: Form 8949 (2022) — Sales and Other Dispositions of Capital Assets

names_shown.title: Name(s) shown on return (Form 8949)
names_shown.description: Form 8949 header field 'Name(s) shown on return'. Extract the string verbatim as printed; null if blank.

ssn_or_taxpayer_id.title: Social security number or taxpayer identification number (Form 8949)
ssn_or_taxpayer_id.description: Form 8949 header field 'Social security number or taxpayer identification number'. On these public-release scans this value is usually masked/redacted: transcribe exactly the characters that are legible; null if fully redacted or blank.

part1_box_a.title: Part I box (A) checkbox
part1_box_a.description: Part I checkbox '(A) Short-term transactions reported on Form(s) 1099-B' — basis was reported to the IRS (see the form's Note). True if checked; false if printed but left unchecked (including when box B or C is checked instead). Two-state policy: exactly one of box A/B/C is true when Part I is used. Return null only if this page is not present.

part1_box_b.title: Part I box (B) checkbox
part1_box_b.description: Part I checkbox '(B) Short-term transactions reported on Form(s) 1099-B' — basis wasn't reported to the IRS. True if checked; false if printed but left unchecked (including when box A or C is checked instead). Two-state policy: exactly one of box A/B/C is true when Part I is used. Return null only if this page is not present.

part1_box_c.title: Part I box (C) checkbox
part1_box_c.description: Part I checkbox '(C) Short-term transactions not reported to you on Form 1099-B'. True if checked; false if printed but left unchecked (including when box A or B is checked instead). Two-state policy: exactly one of box A/B/C is true when Part I is used. Return null only if this page is not present.

part1_short_term_transactions.title: Part I line 1 short-term transactions
part1_short_term_transactions.description: Part I line 1 transaction grid, columns (a) 'Description of property' through (h) 'Gain or (loss)'. The printed 2022 form provides 14 blank rows per page; one row per listed transaction, in print order top to bottom; empty grid (no transactions listed on this page) → null.

line_2_short_term_totals_proceeds.title: Part I line 2 totals — column (d) proceeds
line_2_short_term_totals_proceeds.description: Part I line '2' 'Totals' row, column (d) 'Proceeds' subtotal: add the amounts in columns (d), (e), (g), and (h), subtracting negative amounts. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

line_2_short_term_totals_cost_basis.title: Part I line 2 totals — column (e) cost or other basis
line_2_short_term_totals_cost_basis.description: Part I line '2' 'Totals' row, column (e) 'Cost or other basis' subtotal: add the amounts in columns (d), (e), (g), and (h), subtracting negative amounts. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

line_2_short_term_totals_adjustment.title: Part I line 2 totals — column (g) amount of adjustment
line_2_short_term_totals_adjustment.description: Part I line '2' 'Totals' row, column (g) 'Amount of adjustment' subtotal: add the amounts in columns (d), (e), (g), and (h), subtracting negative amounts. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

line_2_short_term_totals_gain_or_loss.title: Part I line 2 totals — column (h) gain or (loss)
line_2_short_term_totals_gain_or_loss.description: Part I line '2' 'Totals' row, column (h) 'Gain or (loss)' subtotal, entered here and included on Schedule D line 1b (Box A), line 2 (Box B), or line 3 (Box C). Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; an amount printed in parentheses or with a leading minus sign is negative; null if the entry box is blank.

part2_box_d.title: Part II box (D) checkbox
part2_box_d.description: Part II checkbox '(D) Long-term transactions reported on Form(s) 1099-B' — basis was reported to the IRS (see the form's Note). True if checked; false if printed but left unchecked (including when box E or F is checked instead). Two-state policy: exactly one of box D/E/F is true when Part II is used. Return null only if this page is not present.

part2_box_e.title: Part II box (E) checkbox
part2_box_e.description: Part II checkbox '(E) Long-term transactions reported on Form(s) 1099-B' — basis wasn't reported to the IRS. True if checked; false if printed but left unchecked (including when box D or F is checked instead). Two-state policy: exactly one of box D/E/F is true when Part II is used. Return null only if this page is not present.

part2_box_f.title: Part II box (F) checkbox
part2_box_f.description: Part II checkbox '(F) Long-term transactions not reported to you on Form 1099-B'. True if checked; false if printed but left unchecked (including when box D or E is checked instead). Two-state policy: exactly one of box D/E/F is true when Part II is used. Two-state policy: true ONLY if this box is marked; false otherwise (unmarked, or not printed on this rendering). Never return null for this field.
third_party_designee_yes.title: Third party designee question

designee_name.description: Third Party Designee "Designee’s" 'name' field. Null when the designee section is blank. Extract the string verbatim as printed; null if blank.
designee_name.title: Designee's name

designee_phone.description: Third Party Designee 'Phone' 'no.' field. Null when the designee section is blank. Extract the string verbatim as printed; null if blank. A pre-printed empty shell like '(    )' with no digits is blank — return null.
designee_phone.title: Designee's phone number

designee_pin.description: Third Party Designee 'Personal identification' number (PIN) field. Null when the designee section is blank. Extract the string verbatim as printed; null if blank.
designee_pin.title: Designee's PIN

your_occupation.description: 'Sign' 'Here' block field 'Your occupation'. Extract the string verbatim as printed; null if blank.
your_occupation.title: Your occupation

your_signature_date.description: 'Sign' 'Here' block: the 'Date' box beside 'Your signature'. Date as written/printed. (Signature presence itself is not modeled.) Extract the string verbatim as printed; null if blank.
your_signature_date.title: Your signature date

your_identity_protection_pin.description: 'Sign' 'Here' block field 'If the IRS sent you an Identity' 'Protection PIN, enter it here'. Extract the string verbatim as printed; null if blank.
your_identity_protection_pin.title: Your identity protection PIN

spouse_occupation.description: 'Sign' 'Here' block field "Spouse’s occupation". Null on non-joint returns. Extract the string verbatim as printed; null if blank.
spouse_occupation.title: Spouse's occupation

spouse_signature_date.description: 'Sign' 'Here' block: the 'Date' box beside "Spouse’s signature. If a joint return, both must sign." Date as written/printed. Null on non-joint returns. Extract the string verbatim as printed; null if blank.
spouse_signature_date.title: Spouse's signature date

spouse_identity_protection_pin.description: 'Sign' 'Here' block field 'If the IRS sent your spouse an' 'Identity Protection PIN, enter it here'. Extract the string verbatim as printed; null if blank.
spouse_identity_protection_pin.title: Spouse's identity protection PIN

phone_no.description: 'Sign' 'Here' block field 'Phone no.' (taxpayer daytime phone). Extract the string verbatim as printed; null if blank.
phone_no.title: Phone number

email_address.description: 'Sign' 'Here' block field 'Email address'. Extract the string verbatim as printed; null if blank.
email_address.title: Email address

preparer_name.description: 'Paid' 'Preparer' 'Use Only' block field "Preparer’s name" (typed/printed name, not the signature). Extract the string verbatim as printed; null if blank.
preparer_name.title: Preparer's name

preparer_signature_date.description: 'Paid' 'Preparer' 'Use Only' block: the 'Date' box beside "Preparer’s signature". Date as printed. Extract the string verbatim as printed; null if blank.
preparer_signature_date.title: Preparer's signature date

preparer_ptin.description: 'Paid' 'Preparer' 'Use Only' block field 'PTIN'. On these public-release scans this value is usually masked/redacted: transcribe exactly the characters that are legible; null if fully redacted or blank.
preparer_ptin.title: Preparer's PTIN

preparer_self_employed_box.description: 'Paid' 'Preparer' 'Use Only' block, 'Check if:' group. True if the 'Self-employed' box is checked; false if the box is printed but left unchecked;. Two-state policy: true ONLY if this box is marked; false otherwise (unmarked, or not printed on this rendering). Never return null for this field.
preparer_self_employed_box.title: Preparer self-employed box

firm_name.description: 'Paid' 'Preparer' 'Use Only' block field "Firm’s name". Extract the string verbatim as printed; null if blank.
firm_name.title: Firm's name

firm_phone.description: 'Paid' 'Preparer' 'Use Only' block: the 'Phone no.' field on the firm rows (beside "Firm’s name"). Extract the string verbatim as printed; null if blank.
firm_phone.title: Firm's phone number

firm_address.description: 'Paid' 'Preparer' 'Use Only' block field "Firm’s address" (full address as one string). On these public-release scans this value is usually masked/redacted: transcribe exactly the characters that are legible; null if fully redacted or blank.
firm_address.title: Firm's address

firm_ein.description: 'Paid' 'Preparer' 'Use Only' block field "Firm’s EIN". On these public-release scans this value is usually masked/redacted: transcribe exactly the characters that are legible; null if fully redacted or blank.
firm_ein.title: Firm's EIN

schedule_1.description: 'SCHEDULE 1' (Form 1040) 2022 'Additional Income and Adjustments to Income'. Null when Schedule 1 is not part of this return.
schedule_1.title: Schedule 1 — Additional Income and Adjustments to Income

schedule_2.description: 'SCHEDULE 2' (Form 1040) 2022 'Additional Taxes'. Null when Schedule 2 is not part of this return.
schedule_2.title: Schedule 2 — Additional Taxes

schedule_3.description: 'SCHEDULE 3' (Form 1040) 2022 'Additional Credits and Payments'. Null when Schedule 3 is not part of this return.
schedule_3.title: Schedule 3 — Additional Credits and Payments

tax_period_beginning_date.description: Form 1040 top line 'other tax year beginning' - the beginning date as printed for a fiscal-year return; null for a calendar-year return where this line is blank.
tax_period_beginning_date.title: Tax Period Beginning Date

tax_period_ending_date.description: Form 1040 top line 'ending' - the ending date as printed for a fiscal-year return; null for a calendar-year return where this line is blank.
tax_period_ending_date.title: Tax Period Ending Date

form_1116.title: Form 1116 (Foreign Tax Credit)
form_1116.description: 'Form 1116' 2022 'Foreign Tax Credit (Individual, Estate, or Trust)'. Null when Form 1116 is not part of this return. If a filer attaches multiple Forms 1116 (one per income category), model only the values from the first/primary attached copy -- do not attempt multi-instance modeling here.

form_2106.title: Form 2106 (Employee Business Expenses)
form_2106.description: 'Form 2106' 2022 'Employee Business Expenses' (for use only by Armed Forces reservists, qualified performing artists, fee-basis state or local government officials, and employees with impairment-related work expenses). Null when Form 2106 is not part of this return.

form_4562.title: Form 4562 (Depreciation and Amortization)
form_4562.description: 'Form 4562' 2022 'Depreciation and Amortization (Including Information on Listed Property)'. Null when Form 4562 is not part of this return.

form_4952.title: Form 4952 (Investment Interest Expense Deduction)
form_4952.description: IRS Form 4952 (2022) 'Investment Interest Expense Deduction'. Computes the deduction for investment interest expense limited to net investment income. Null if not attached. May be attached TWICE (regular + AMT) -- reuse this same def for both instances.

form_8995.title: Form 8995 (QBI Deduction - Simplified)
form_8995.description: IRS Form 8995 (2022) 'Qualified Business Income Deduction Simplified Computation'. Used when taxable income before QBI deduction is at or below the simplified-computation threshold. Null if not attached (e.g. Form 8995-A used instead).

form_6251.title: Form 6251 (Alternative Minimum Tax—Individuals)
form_6251.description: 'Form 6251' 2022 'Alternative Minimum Tax—Individuals'. Null when Form 6251 is not part of this return.

form_7203.title: Form 7203 (S Corporation Shareholder Stock and Debt Basis Limitations)
form_7203.description: 'Form 7203' 2022 'S Corporation Shareholder Stock and Debt Basis Limitations'. Filed by an S corporation shareholder to figure the allowable amount of certain deductions, losses, and other items that require a stock and/or debt basis limitation. A shareholder may attach a separate Form 7203 for each S corporation and, in some cases, a second copy computed under AMT rules; this field models a single copy. Null if Form 7203 is not part of this return.

form_8283.title: Form 8283 (Noncash Charitable Contributions)
form_8283.description: 'Form 8283' (Rev. November 2022) 'Noncash Charitable Contributions'. Attach one or more Forms 8283 to the return if the filer claimed a total deduction of over $500 for all contributed property. Null when Form 8283 is not part of this return.

form_8582.title: Form 8582 (Passive Activity Loss Limitations)
form_8582.description: 'Form 8582' 2022 'Passive Activity Loss Limitations'. Null when Form 8582 is not part of this return.

form_8879.title: Form 8879 (IRS e-file Signature Authorization)
form_8879.description: 'Form 8879' 2022 'IRS e-file Signature Authorization' — the taxpayer's declaration and PIN-based signature authorization letting an electronic return originator (ERO) e-file the return, plus (if the Practitioner PIN method is used) the ERO's own certification in Part III. Null if Form 8879 is not part of this return.

form_8949.title: Form 8949 (Sales and Other Dispositions of Capital Assets)
form_8949.description: 'Form 8949' 2022 'Sales and Other Dispositions of Capital Assets'. Null when Form 8949 is not part of this return.

form_8959.title: Form 8959 (Additional Medicare Tax)
form_8959.description: 'Form 8959' 2022 'Additional Medicare Tax'. Null when Form 8959 is not part of this return.

form_8960.title: Form 8960 (Net Investment Income Tax)
form_8960.description: 'Form 8960' 2022 'Net Investment Income Tax'— Individuals, Estates, and Trusts; attached to the tax return to compute the 3.8% surtax on net investment income. Null when Form 8960 is not part of this return.

schedule_8812.title: Schedule 8812 (Credits for Qualifying Children and Other Dependents)
schedule_8812.description: 'SCHEDULE 8812' (Form 1040) 2022 'Credits for Qualifying Children and Other Dependents'. Null when Schedule 8812 is not part of this return.

schedule_a.title: Schedule A (Itemized Deductions)
schedule_a.description: 'SCHEDULE A' (Form 1040) 2022 'Itemized Deductions'. Null when Schedule A is not part of this return.

schedule_b.title: Schedule B (Interest and Ordinary Dividends)
schedule_b.description: Schedule B (Form 1040) 2022 'Interest and Ordinary Dividends' — Part I interest payer list, Part II ordinary dividend payer list, and Part III foreign accounts and trusts questions. Null if Schedule B is not attached to this return.

schedule_c.title: Schedule C (Profit or Loss From Business)
schedule_c.description: 'SCHEDULE C' (Form 1040) 2022 'Profit or Loss From Business (Sole Proprietorship)'. Null when Schedule C is not part of this return.

schedule_d.title: Schedule D (Capital Gains and Losses)
schedule_d.description: 'SCHEDULE D' (Form 1040) 2022 'Capital Gains and Losses' — Part I short-term and Part II long-term capital gain/loss summary lines (fed from Form 8949 and other named forms/schedules), and Part III summary computation with its Yes/No routing questions. Null when Schedule D is not part of this return.

schedule_e.title: Schedule E (Supplemental Income and Loss)
schedule_e.description: 'SCHEDULE E' (Form 1040) 2022 'Supplemental Income and Loss (From rental real estate, royalties, partnerships, S corporations, estates, trusts, REMICs, etc.)'. Null when Schedule E is not part of this return.

schedule_se.title: Schedule SE (Self-Employment Tax)
schedule_se.description: Schedule SE (Form 1040) 2022 'Self-Employment Tax' — computes self-employment tax on net earnings from self-employment. This is a single-filer form: one Schedule SE per person with self-employment income (a joint return with two self-employed spouses attaches two separate Schedule SE forms). Null if this schedule is not attached to the return.
